description: The Purple Billboard client-acquisition system, wired end to end. Use it when the owner asks for the Purple Billboard Playbook, a billboard post, a hook and reveal thread, a giveaway keyword campaign, a monthly 30-pack of daily posts with one monthly approval, a comment-to-DM or DM-door flow, original gift or Bonus delivery, mobile and email capture with reminders, or booking and human handoff that comes out of a post. It routes each step of the flow (discovery, asset inventory, monthly approval, publication through Skills 35 and 57, comment and DM routing, original fulfillment, bonus, capture, reminders, booking and handoff, outcomes) to the exact module that already implements it in Skills 38, 44 and 35 and in shared-utils, and states the safety boundaries. It adds no new engine, scheduler, router or endpoint.
